newsitem.title: USA: Atlantic Coast adding flights in 3 cities.
newsitem.headline: Atlantic Coast adding flights in 3 cities.

text.p: Atlantic Coast Airlines Inc said Friday it is increasing its service to three cities as of September 9.
The airline, which operates in the eastern part of the United States as United Express, plans to expand service in Hartford, Conn., Greensboro, N.C., and Charleston, W.Va.
With the additional flights, United Express will offer more than 200 daily departures from Washington's Dulles International Airport.

United Express will add one non-stop, round-trip flight to Hartford for a total of five weekday trips. Two nonstop, round-trip flights are to be added to Greensboro for a total of eight. And one non-stop, round-trip flight is being added to Charleston, for a total of four.
